meta.method: Curves extracted from the PDF vector paths of the Excel charts (exact curve geometry, Bezier/polyline evaluated), axes calibrated by snapping tick labels to gridlines (calibration residual <0.4% of one major division). Every series was checked by overlaying the points on a 130 dpi render. Points are on the curve at nice x values (tick values + endpoints + extra points where linear interpolation would err >0.5%); linear interpolation between points reproduces the printed curve to about 0.5%. Typical reading accuracy ~0.1-0.3% of axis span.
meta.units: x and y are stored in REAL units (axis display multipliers such as Thousands/Millions already applied); see x.unit, y.unit; x.multiplier / y.multiplier record the factor that was applied to the printed axis labels.
meta.fit_note: 'fit' (where present) is a least-squares convenience formula on the digitised curve, real units, max_rel_err over the visible range; use points for fidelity.
meta.not_found: No graph pages exist after M/18 in Section A (book p115 is the Elevators section divider).
